summary.text: Elephant tusk flame is a rank seven immortal material, a pea-sized flame that burns inside a dead ancient desolate beast elephant's tusk.

claims.text: Elephant tusk flame is a tiny lump of flame that burns in an elephant’s tusk after an ancient desolate beast elephant dies. The lump is about the size of a pea; once it finishes burning the tusk, contact with outside air extinguishes it. An ancient desolate beast elephant equals a rank seven Gu Immortal, and the tusk does not produce the flame after every death. With those conditions, the flame is precious even in treasure yellow heaven, the market of the five regions. Old Ancestor Xue Hu orders Fairy Li Shan to gather it as one of three immortal materials; among concealing heaven dust, rock dragon eye, and elephant tusk flame, only the flame is called slightly simple to obtain. Rock dragon eye and elephant tusk flame are rank seven immortal materials on that order.
Elephant tusk flame is listed among flames taken in quantity with date flame, phoenix song flame, black lantern blind fire, firefly flame, flying flame, dragon snake dancing flame, and others.
